# hostinger_vps_data_centers (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `data_centers` (Attributes List) List of VPS data centers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_centers))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--data_centers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_centers`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) Data center location city.
- `continent` (String) Data center location continent.
- `id` (Number) Data center ID.
- `location` (String) Data center location country (two-letter code).
- `name` (String) Data center name.
